purpose: Define an Expose editor/monitor boundary for policy candidates, semantic diffs, validation, revision/activation state, decision-cache validity and change audit.

topics.name: AccessCore Policy Change Monitor
topics.purpose: Define an Expose editor/monitor boundary for policy candidates, semantic diffs, validation, revision/activation state, decision-cache validity and change audit.

semantics.candidate_rule: Editing remains candidate-only until explicit authorized apply.
semantics.identity_rule: Policy identity, revision, candidate, evaluator snapshot, cache entry and audit record identities remain distinct.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing/editing candidate grants no policy administration authority.
semantics.secret_rule: Sensitive auth material is never rendered.

invariants.rule: Identity, authentication assurance, authorization policy, authorization decision, delegation and runtime execution remain separate machine-significant identities/evidence; no one layer silently substitutes for another.

Ambiguous, missing, stale or unverifiable authority for a protected effect fails closed rather than inheriting trust from locality, transport reachability, process ownership, UI visibility or previous success.

hard_gates.condition: editor changes live policy while typing
